answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 173 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is published against the summit challenge, the signal audit can replay the pigment history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 1596 identities would post 1020 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted.
